phase_name: Document parsing, OCR and visual-region extraction
changes: Searchable PDF page text extraction with stable line offsets and rotation-aware rendered-page pixel polygons
Bounded scanned-PDF OCR using configurable Tesseract language, maximum OCR pages, render DPI, maximum dimension and timeout
Explicit PDF extraction warnings for low confidence, empty OCR, OCR failure and scanned pages beyond the configured page cap
Authenticated PDF page preview endpoint with resource authorization, CLEAN scan gate and SHA-256 integrity verification
Review Workbench PDF page navigation and selectable source text/OCR polygon overlays
DOCX logical extraction preserving headings, paragraphs, runs, table rows/cells, headers and footers with character offsets
DOCX inline image dimensions and alt-text inventory without claiming rendered page coordinates or embedded-image OCR
Image OCR metadata includes EXIF-corrected dimensions, line/word polygons, extraction confidence, Tesseract language and engine version
Versioned 64-bit dHash candidate signal, descriptive palette inventory and policy-scoped palette comparison
Conservative local OCR-line contrast measurements with PASS, FAIL and UNMEASURABLE metadata and human review routing
Finding source-region resolution now prefers the most specific containing DOCX run/table-cell or visual line region
Phase 06 unit and integration regressions for rotated/searchable/scanned PDFs, DOCX offsets, visual metadata and page preview

skip_reasons: PostgreSQL RLS enforcement (requires PostgreSQL CI service)
Concurrent version/publication locking (requires PostgreSQL CI service)
verification.typescript_syntax_parse: passed for 17 frontend .ts/.tsx files with zero syntax diagnostics
verification.frontend_lint_typecheck_build: not verified; local dependency installation incomplete and clean install attempt timed out
verification.live_postgresql: not run locally; PostgreSQL CI job configured
verification.live_clamav: not run locally; existing scanner tests cover injected states/protocol
verification.live_s3_or_minio: not run locally; existing adapter tests use fake S3 client

limitations: DOCX rendered page geometry is not implemented; logical character offsets are provided and no page position is fabricated
Embedded image pixels inside DOCX and independently placed images/logos inside otherwise searchable PDFs are not OCRed
Tesseract language support depends on the language data installed on the deployment host
PDF table extraction is best-effort metadata; canonical text mapping remains page line regions
Perceptual-hash similarity and palette checks are candidate signals and do not certify logo identity or brand fit
Local contrast is an OCR-line estimate and does not certify complete creative or WCAG conformance
PostgreSQL RLS/concurrency, live ClamAV, S3/MinIO, browser E2E and full frontend production build remain externally unverified
